notes:
{一人一人|ひとりひとり} emphasizes treating each individual separately within a group. It functions as both a noun and an adverb.

ALTERNATIVE WRITING:
- {一人一人|ひとりひとり} (all kanji)
- {一人|ひとり}ひとり (mixed — common in print)
- ひとりひとり (all hiragana)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {一人一人|ひとりひとり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: to each person
- {一人一人|ひとりひとり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun: each person's ~
- {一人一人|ひとりひとり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧: each person (as subject)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦それぞれ→それぞれ：01453_sorezore⟧: each, respectively (general — can apply to things too)
- ⟦{各々|おのおの}→各々：00334_onoono⟧: each one (formal/literary)
- ⟦{個々|ここ}→個々：11619_koko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: individually (more abstract)
- ⟦めいめい→めいめい：03976_meimei⟧: each person (slightly old-fashioned)
